newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Triple P sees fresh management restructure.
newsitem.headline: Triple P sees fresh management restructure.

text.p: Dutch software and automation company Triple P NV said on Wednesday it envisaged further management restructuring after hiring a new chief financial officer and a new chief operating officer.
"The company anticipates further management restructuring in order to position itself for profitable operations in 1997," the company said in a statement with third quarter results.

Announcing a third quarter net loss of 24.04 million guilders, against a 2.93 million guilder profit in the same 1995 period, Triple P said it had sold three and rationalised one non-strategic business units to date.
It said it planned to sell or rationalise another three business units in 1997.
"In connection with the restructuring, the company is rationalising and strengthening both its senior and line of business management structures," said Triple P. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
